scripts.migrate: cd packages/platform && wrangler d1 migrations apply vite-cloud-platform
scripts.migrate:staging: cd packages/platform && wrangler d1 migrations apply vite-cloud-platform-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.deploy: pnpm deploy:dispatch && pnpm deploy:platform && pnpm deploy:admin
scripts.deploy:platform: pnpm migrate --remote && cd packages/platform && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm deploy:staging:dispatch && pnpm deploy:staging:platform && pnpm deploy:staging:admin
scripts.deploy:staging:platform: pnpm migrate:staging && cd packages/platform && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:docs: pnpm deploy:mcp && cd packages/website && pnpm run deploy
